claims.statement: For an online structured invoice, KSeF assigns legally relevant issuance and receipt timestamps, including receipt on assignment of the KSeF identifier.
EU late-payment rules provide creditors with interest and a fixed recovery-cost compensation when the statutory conditions are met.

contrary_evidence: A timestamp proves timing, not that every invoice is undisputed or collectible; contract-specific defences can defeat recovery.

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: Verified recovery outcomes build debtor-payment, evidence sufficiency and partner-execution benchmarks
fingerprint.customer: Polish bookkeeping practices and invoice-finance firms serving cash-constrained SME creditors
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: Embedded module for accountants, ERP resellers and factors
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Consented evidence-to-recovery workflow with outcome fee
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: The creditor or finance partner pays only after recovered cash is matched to the overdue invoice or statutory recovery item
fingerprint.problem_trigger: A B2B invoice passes its contractual due date without matched payment

founder_fit: Data matching and automation suit the founder's skills
Asynchronous channel sales reduce constant social effort
Can begin part-time with one accounting partner
Verified recoveries create a reusable data asset
risks: Channel partners may internalize the workflow

structure.commercial_archetype: Outcome-priced B2B recovery infrastructure embedded in accounting and invoice-finance channels
structure.control_point: The consented evidence packet, deadline clock and cash-reconciliation record that determines when a recovery fee is earned
structure.critical_dependency: Lawful KSeF and bank-data access plus a recovery workflow reviewed for Polish debt-collection and legal-services boundaries

thesis: With each creditor's consent, combine immutable KSeF receipt dates, invoice terms and bank-payment evidence into accountant-approved recovery packets, then charge only when overdue interest or recovery compensation is actually paid. The product is a transaction rail, not a receivables dashboard: it detects the trigger, preserves evidence, routes the approved action through a qualified legal or accounting partner where needed, and reconciles the recovered cash.
title: KSeF Late-Payment Recovery Rail
uncertainties: Accountant willingness to sponsor outcome fees
